scope: Sourcing recommendation only; no schematic, active library or BOM edits.
use: Shared five-cap 10uF bank for VBUS x2 and PMID x3; required effective minima at 21V are VBUS >=2uF and PMID >=4uF.

listing_snapshot.caveat: Volatile LCSC listing snapshot; recheck price and stock before purchase.

datasheet_and_curve.assessment: About 3.86uF/part estimated after simple initial-tolerance and X7R-limit derating; totals about 7.72uF VBUS and 11.57uF PMID at 21V, above the requested 2uF/4uF minima. The underlying DC-bias curve is typical only; validate measured effective capacitance/ripple and aging/temperature in the final design.

package_assets.footprint: Existing project DesktopSpeaker:PD_C_1210, geometry identical to installed KiCad Capacitor_SMD:C_1210_3225Metric (1210 / 3225 metric).
package_assets.body_model: Existing project model DesktopSpeaker-kicad/kicad-library/3d/PD_C_1210.step. SHA-256 matches installed official KiCad C_1210_3225Metric.step exactly. FreeCAD 1.0.0 validated one solid, bounds 3.2 x 2.5 x 2.5 mm. Generic standard package model, not Samsung-specific geometry.

selected_candidate.why_selected: Lower-cost source than the comparable Murata 1210 10uF/50V X7R at the current LCSC snapshot, with 1-piece MOQ and large displayed stock; same footprint and package body model.

listing_snapshot.caveat: Volatile listing snapshot; recheck before purchase.

charger_reference: Local TI BQ25792 Rev C datasheet §10.2.2.2 shows 2 x 10uF VBUS and 3 x 10uF PMID bank. Root-provided effective minima 2uF and 4uF are carried as design requirements.
